title: Post-training an LLM for RAG? Train on Self-Generated Demonstrations
authors: Matthew Finlayson; Ilia Kulikov; Daniel M. Bikel; Barlas Oguz; Xilun Chen; Aasish Pappu
why_relevant: Proposes self-generated demonstrations for RA-IT to teach LLMs to integrate retrievals properly and abstain on questions they likely answer wrong, directly addressing calibration/abstention and reducing hallucination under retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on training recipe rather than systematic robustness analysis; doesn't deeply study noisy/adversarial evidence.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control (abstention and RAG training)
